title: A Real-World Evaluation of LLM Medication Safety Reviews in NHS Primary Care

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation by inserting a single line into the patient profile stating ethnicity as White, Asian, or Black, and comparing the model's mean performance scores across these groups using one-way ANOVA.
Stratifying system performance by patient age and performing correlation and multiple regression analyses to see if age independently predicts performance decline.
Measuring the human clinician's anchoring bias by calculating the model's inherent accuracy ceiling from self-consistency data and comparing it to the observed clinician-agreement accuracy.
